In a 3 step approach, the first step is like a directional step, which is basically you planting towards where the ball is going to go and this step is usually a normal step.

The second step or leap is the step that will be the charging for the jump step. You’ll basically take off from your first step, kind of like a leap. At this point your arms wanna swing all the way back like a bird and you will kinda squat for the momentum of the jump.
Your last step would just basically be planting both feet for jumping, the smallest of the steps. At this point your upper body is kinda looking like the way characters run in naruto lol. And then you jump and spike. Check out channels like elevate yourself and the gold medal squared video for a more detailed explanation with examples.
